title: The "recognised test gets no credit … ran after another command on its line" warning appeared in a turn whose shell commands contained no recognised test
outcome: TermAl raises the near-miss notice (engram_one_call.rs:172-206; engram_source_roots.rs:959-962) only for a command whose segment after an unquoted `;` or `&&` is a recognised test (engram_check_recognition.rs:384-444), and the notice names that command, so a holder can tell what it refers to. A turn that ran no such command gets no such notice.
acceptance: The holder's note identifies, from host records or a reproduction, which command or event produced the notice in the occurrence below (for example a Codex code-mode or JS orchestration call whose text holds launcher command strings, a late attribution of an earlier turn's command, or a carried check), with file:line.
A test reproduces the false notice from that input and shows that, after the fix, no near-miss notice is raised for it, while the genuine `A && TEST` near miss still raises one.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Fixed the false test near-miss notice for non-test commands and retained the genuine A && TEST notice. Independent acceptance evaluation b0127db81c0e440f81fe1a2596498053 passed 3/3; full gate test-1708ffa4-aa37-4c37-9a31-8fb60b12e0fa passed 5/5. Integration owner pushed bd83915341786d2137d7c63668b7adc9e0add50e to origin/master as a fast-forward from c6216f31; local master and origin/master both verify at that commit.
